contest.title: THE PUSH
contest.outcome.withdrew.title: The other side gave up.
contest.outcome.broke.title: Yours gave up first.
contest.outcome.limit.title: Nobody gave up today.
contest.outcome.withdrew.body: They leave by the same road they came in on. The wall is still where it was, and so are you.
contest.outcome.broke.body: They pull back anyway, late. What was half-done on your stretch is loose stone again; what was already standing is still standing. Tomorrow it gets laid again.
contest.outcome.limit.body: The whole day went by without either side giving way. They leave tired, and they come back whenever they like.
contest.move.watch.spent_note: They have seen the torch once already, and they don't look twice.
contest.log.page_unlocked: The wall is still standing, and now there is one more way to answer.
contest.log.hold.built: Nobody moves. The stretch you raised takes the push.
contest.log.hold.bare: Nobody moves. Behind you the wall is still an idea.
contest.log.call.answered: You call, and the ones who know you by name answer.
contest.log.call.unanswered: You call. On your side nobody knows who is calling.
contest.log.watch.spent: The same torch, the same path. The other side has already counted it.
contest.log.watch.posted: The torch runs the top of the wall end to end, and there are people at each end.
contest.log.watch.unposted: The torch runs a short stretch. There isn't much to show.
contest.log.half_and_half: They expected one thing or the other. They find both.
contest.log.enemy.1: On the other side they come forward a few steps and stop, so you can count how many they are.
contest.log.enemy.2: They beat spear on shield, in time, without moving from where they stand.
contest.log.enemy.3: A stone hits the top of the wall. Nobody is hurt, and that is exactly what wears you down.
contest.log.enemy.4: They shout all day without attacking. Some of yours look towards the road home.
contest.log.end.withdrew: The other side pulls back. Nobody comes down off the wall to go after them.
contest.log.end.broke: Yours let go of the line, and the other side pulls back anyway, late. What was half-done on your stretch is loose stone again; what was already standing is still standing.
contest.log.end.limit: They tire before you do and leave without saying anything.

help.title: What to do now
help.all_done: Nothing new here for the moment.
help.step.talk: Tap somebody in the village. People answer, and what they tell you changes what you know how to do.
help.step.gather: The rubble piles turn into material. Tap one to pick it up.
help.step.build: Tap a stretch of the wall to raise it with the material you are carrying. The day's work is limited.
help.step.read: Every citation carries Learn more. It opens the whole chapter, in here, and you come back where you left off.
help.step.rest: When the day's work runs out, the mat by your door ends the day.
help.step.split: Ending the day, you split who works and who keeps watch. Both matter.
help.step.trial: On the third day the village is put to the test. What was said there is what you have to answer with.
